items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: During that time I don't know no Negro singer could sing like Ethel Waters and had the personality and still got it, that she's had ever since I've known her.

ctx.x: In other words, Bessie Smith was really more representative of the people than Ethel Waters.
